 SBI Clerk Prelims result 2026: SBI Junior Associate scorecard today at sbi.bank.in, details here
 ADVERTISEMENT
 SBI Clerk Prelims result 2026: SBI Junior Associate scorecard today at sbi.bank.in, details here
 The State Bank of India (SBI) is expected to announce the SBI Clerk Preliminary Examination Result 2026 on November 18. Students can check the complete details here to learn more.
 Curated By Akshita Jolly 
 Image: Canva 
 Nov 18, 2026
 Share
 The State Bank of India (SBI) is expected to release the SBI Clerk Preliminary Examination Result 2026 on November 18. Those who appeared for the exam are eagerly waiting for the results.  
 However, SBI has not officially confirmed the result date or time. As per the latest updates, the result is still awaited. Once the result is out, students will be able to check it via the official website, sbi.bank.in. 
 The preliminary exam took place on 26 and 27 September 2026 for the recruitment of Junior Associates (Customer Support and Sales). The recruitment drive aims to fill about 7,680 regular vacancies, along with backlog vacancies. 
 What are the steps to download the SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026? 
 Here are the steps provided below to download the SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026:  
 Visit the official SBI website at sbi.bank.in. 
 Open the ‘Careers’ section and click on ‘Current Openings’. 
 Find the Junior Associate recruitment notification. 
 Look for the link that says SBI Clerk Prelims Result. 
 Enter your registration number or roll number and password or date of birth, if required. 
 Submit the details to check your result. 
 Download your scorecard and take a printout for future reference. 
 SBI is also expected to release the category-wise and state-wise cut-off marks along with the preliminary examination results or scorecards. 
 Those who qualify in the preliminary exam will be eligible to appear for the SBI Clerk Mains examination, scheduled for November 26 and 27, 2026. The mains exam is the next stage of the selection process.  
 Keep visiting the official website for more such updates and notifications.
